statement: There are 7 irreducible rational plane curves of degree 3 through 5 general points with contact order 3 to a fixed line at a specified point of the line.

source.location: Corollary 4.8; Theorem 4.9, equation (4.6); Figure 8, d=3,4 rows

origin.inheritance_basis: Use z(d) with d=3; z(2)=1 follows from the recurrence and Figure 8 gives z(3)=7,z(4)=138.
